evidence: Same Spec executes publicly authored architecture, complete candidate reads, mandatory copy to its task, individual/batch classification, Spec validation/evaluation, execution, implementation/test records, failed premature completion, permitted review, idempotent replay and final Done.

Native schema enforces request-open, accepted receipt, current head and request-consumed before execution. Existing test helper corrected to seed valid lineage; no trigger disabled.
Observed call reduction is exactly 25/84 = 29.7619%, not 30%. Fixture was not enlarged to meet target.

limits: This compares native individual versus batch strategies from a controlled Draft starting boundary through Done; initial authored requirements/grants and external implementation receipt are controlled inputs.

Token counts use cl100k_base; timing is a single in-process sample, not billing or production latency. External execution time is nested in MCP and is not added twice.
